workspace.text:

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:

- Monday: 11:00-12:00
- Tuesday: 09:00-10:00
- Wednesday: 13:00-14:00
- Thursday: 09:30-10:00 or 14:30-15:30

Could you check Priya and Marcus's calendars to see which of these slots work for them? We need a 30-minute slot within any of these windows where all four are free.
